<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bottom(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('w','c') and any(p[0]==63 for p in n['boundary']):
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; d[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return d
print("bottom bar over history:")
for h in history[::6]:
    print(f"  step{h.frame.step:3d}", bottom(h.frame))
# Now cycle slot0: currently at col15 (slot0). Do 14 UPs, record glyph each time.
def glyph_at(fr, r0,r1,c0,c1):
    lines=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]; cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    if not rs: return None
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
def show(s): return ' '.join(''.join(r) for r in s) if s else 'None'
seen=[]
for k in range(14):
    action(['UP'])
    g=glyph_at(current_frame,51,58,15,22)
    tag=''
    if g not in [x[1] for x in seen]: tag='NEW'
    seen.append((k,g))
    print(f"UP{k+1}: {show(g)} {tag}")
# check B0 membership
init=history[0].frame
B0=glyph_at(init,40,47,15,22)
print("B0:",show(B0)," in slot0 set:", B0 in [x[1] for x in seen])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
